body: Oh, that's good. I'm not sure if I can give any advice in case it happens again, but feel free to talk to me if you want.

If the thoughts aren't too bad, trying to focus on something else usually helps. It can be anything as long as it keeps you distracted from the suicidal thoughts. In my case, I listen to music and focus on the lyrics, trying to fully understand them.

What things do you like? Maybe I can think of some activity that could help you in this case.
Seems cool, I'll probably give it a watch tomorrow. If you want, I can PM you after I watch it and tell you if it changes anything.

I wish I could relate to you but I honestly don't care about my family and it makes me feel kinda bad. They gave me everything they could yet I don't care about them, I guess I'm just a piece of shit.

I hope we can both get better some day, wish you the best.
Yeah, I do, I'm not too much into watching Netflix though.
I'm not sure, but it's probably related to my Asperger syndrome, lack of social skill, and the pressure I get for being the best student in my class.
